cases.name: ordinary full roster: every player has known raw minutes and a known value
bench-default-minutes and replacement-value fallback: athlete_id 104 has neither raw_minutes nor value_per36 on record
absorption_off: the SAME 3 remaining players as absorption_on, no absent player supplied at all (plain allocate_minutes, ghost_minutes must read 0)

absorption_on: same 3 remaining players as absorption_off, athlete_id 204 removed and supplied as absent with his own (no-hindsight) raw minutes -- absorption_phi of his minutes must land on the ghost slot, the rest spread proportionally across the 3 remaining players

fictional player with a declared per-36 value -- ARITHMETIC IDENTITY ONLY: a directly-supplied value_per36 is honored exactly, with no lookup. The unconverted-units/DB-resolution semantics that make a value 'fictional' in the first place are outside this ported function set -- see the section docstring above
delta identity, part 1: team A's full roster (2 players)
delta identity, part 2: team A with athlete_id 402 removed (only team A's OWN raw_strength/off/def/net may differ from part 1 -- team B, part 3, must be unaffected)

delta identity, part 3: team B, computed under the SAME top-level league_recenter as parts 1-2 -- there is no per-case recenter for team A's edit to disturb, which is what makes 'editing one team moves every other team's rating' structurally impossible here
v2 split only: eleven men with genuine per-side values, plain proportional minutes -- off/def stop being +net/2 and -net/2, tilt is non-zero, net is unchanged
v2 depth chart only: the SAME eleven men, no per-side values -- the rotation curve makes the top of the rotation heavier and the bench lighter, which moves raw_strength
v2 depth chart deep bench: seventeen men, so ranks 16 and 17 both fall past the curve's last entry and must SHARE that value -- the branch an off-by-one port breaks

v2 rank key by value: a fictional add (9101) and a no-history man (9102), neither with a minutes history, are slotted by interpolating their own value against their history-having teammates' (minutes, value) pairs -- the trade-arrival branch

v2 rank key clamped both ends: a superstar arrival (9104, better than anyone already here) and a minimum-salary arrival (9105, worse than anyone already here) -- neither value falls INSIDE his teammates' range, so both must be held flat at the top and bottom of the chart rather than extrapolated off the end of it
v2 absorption baseline: the eleven-man rotation under the v2 formula with nobody absent -- the A side of the pair, so ghost_minutes must read 0

v2 absorption: the SAME eleven men, with 1112 (24.0 raw minutes) removed and supplied as absent -- the rotation curve is blended into the REMAINING men only, then the untouched absorption formula sends absorption_phi of his minutes to the ghost
v2 full: the Split, the Depth Chart, a fictional add, an absent man, and 9103 with neither minutes nor value on record so both fallbacks fire inside the composed path
v3 goto concentrated: one man takes about a third of the projected points -- the term is positive and raw_strength decomposes as the minutes-weighted sum plus goto_credit
v3 goto flat: eleven near-equal scorers -- the leading share sits under the league reference and the term is negative
v3 goto clamped at the top rail: a 60-a-night man among non-scorers -- the raw share is over one half and the term reads star_goto_share_band[1], never the raw share
v3 goto clamped at the floor: twelve men projected for identical points on plain proportional minutes -- raw share one twelfth, priced at star_goto_share_band[0]
v3 goto no scoring history: the leading man's pts_per36 is null and he contributes nothing to the projection -- the share is read off the other ten
v3 goto absent star: the concentrated roster with its scorer declared out -- the ghost slot carries no scoring rate and the share is read off the remaining men
v3 goto declared off: the concentrated roster and its pts_per36 inputs priced under the v2 family -- goto_credit must be exactly 0, the contract gates the term

description: The pricing-layer cross-implementation fixture (GitHub issue #24) -- a FIXED, SYNTHETIC roster + values feeding the REAL hoops.rosterratings.raw_team_strength/team_net_rating -> known raw_strength/off/def/net/tilt per case. Schema matches keith-hub's own lib/hoops/pricing.ts + scripts/check-hoops-pricing-fixture.ts exactly (the receiver shipped first; its shape is authoritative per the issue #24 amendment, 2026-08-05). EVERY case carries its own `features` list and must be priced under THAT list, not under the bundle's contract.features -- the v1 family (symmetric_off_def, plain proportional minutes) is a permanent backward-compatibility regression set, and the v2 family (split_off_def + depth_chart_minutes) is the hub-v2 formula. Port teamNetRating/rawTeamStrength/allocateMinutes/allocateMinutesWithAbsorption/allocateMinutesDepthChart against THIS and reproduce every case's `expected` block to 1e-6 before trusting a roster edit's priced effect.
